youtube.title: Alexander the Great slid into Diogenes' DMs 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
The king of the whole world texted a guy who lives in a jar. It did NOT go well. ☀️🏺

Alexander offered gold, palaces, a whole empire... Diogenes just wanted his sun back.

Who won this one? 👇 Comment who should be in the next group chat.

Parody · fictional chat. Based on the famous (and probably exaggerated) meeting of Alexander and Diogenes in Corinth, 336 BC.

#history #historymemes #alexanderthegreat #diogenes #philosophy #shorts #funny
